name: Alley
desc1: This alleyway is dark and seems to be well-traveled, due to the fact
desc2: that the debris is pushed up against the walls to clear a path. There
desc3: is a large, steel-banded door in the wall of a nondescript house to
desc4: the north. Its windows are carefully shuttered, and you can hear faint
desc5: movement noises from within. The alley continues to the west, and
desc6: opens onto a street to the east.
